'''Daniel Hershkowitz''' ({{langx|he|דניאל הרשקוביץ}}; born 2 January 1953 in [[Haifa]], Israel) is an Israeli politician, [[mathematician]], and [[Orthodox Judaism|Orthodox]] [[rabbi]]. Since 2018, he has headed the  {{ill|Israel Civil Service Commission|he|נציבות שירות המדינה}}. He is [[professor emeritus]] of [[mathematics]] at [[the Technion]], and is also rabbi of the [[Haifa#Neighborhoods|Ahuza neighborhood]] in [[Haifa]]. He was president of [[Bar-Ilan University]] from 2013-17.

==Early life==
Hershkowitz was born in [[Haifa]]. His parents were [[Holocaust survivors]] from [[Hungary]], and his father was wounded in the [[1948 Arab-Israeli War]]. 
Hershkowitz studied at a religious high school, and graduated at age 16. He served for five years in the [[Intelligence Corps (Israel)|Intelligence Corps]] of the [[Israel Defense Forces]], reaching the rank of Major.

Hershkowitz earned his BSc in mathematics in 1973, MSc in 1976, and DSc in 1982, all from the [[Technion – Israel Institute of Technology]]. His [[yeshiva]] [[Torah study|studies]] were conducted at [[Mercaz HaRav]]; he received his ''[[Semikha]]'' (ordination) in 1995 from Rabbis [[She'ar Yashuv Cohen]], Shlomo Chelouche, and Nehemyah Roth, as well as an additional ordination [[Chief Rabbinate of Israel#Semikhah|"Rabbi of the City"]] from the [[Chief Rabbinate of Israel]] (2001).<ref name="daniel-h.co.il"/>

==Academia==
He has published over 80 mathematics articles in [[academic journal]]s. He was President of the ''[[International Linear Algebra Society]]''<ref>[http://mirror.math.temple.edu/iic/ International Linear Algebra Society] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080724232744/http://mirror.math.temple.edu/iic/ |date=24 July 2008 }}</ref> (2002-2008<ref>[http://www.ilasic.math.uregina.ca/iic/misc/pastofficers.html ILAS Officers] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070707215359/http://www.ilasic.math.uregina.ca/iic/misc/pastofficers.html |date=7 July 2007 }}</ref>), and was previously a Professor of Mathematics at the [[University of Wisconsin–Madison]].<ref name=bht/><ref name="daniel-h.co.il">[http://www.daniel-h.co.il/ביוגרפיה.htm daniel-h.co.il] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130927201718/http://www.daniel-h.co.il/%D7%91%D7%99%D7%95%D7%92%D7%A8%D7%A4%D7%99%D7%94.htm |date=27 September 2013 }}</ref> In 1982, he was awarded the Landau Research Prize in Mathematics; in 1990, the New England Academic Award for Excellence in Research; in 1990, the Technion's Award for Excellence in Teaching; and in 1991, the Henri Gutwirth Award for Promotion of Research.<ref name=bht/>

==Political career==
In 2009, he was elected to the [[Knesset]] as the leader of [[the Jewish Home]], and was appointed [[Science and Technology Minister of Israel|Minister of Science and Technology]] after joining [[Benjamin Netanyahu]]'s [[Thirty-second government of Israel|government]].<ref name=bht>[http://www.borhatorah.org/eshop/biography.php?id=8 Biography] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110728095142/http://www.borhatorah.org/eshop/biography.php?id=8 |date=28 July 2011 }}, borhatorah.org</ref><ref>[https://www.haaretz.com/hasen/spages/1075341.html Netanyahu sworn in as Israel's prime minister] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100102083155/http://haaretz.com/hasen/spages/1075341.html |date=2 January 2010 }} Haaretz, 1 April 2009.</ref><ref>[http://www.most.gov.il/English/About/Minister/default.htm "Prof. Daniel Hershkowitz"] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120701090710/http://www.most.gov.il/English/About/Minister/default.htm |date=1 July 2012 }}, a profile at Ministry of Science and Technology website</ref> He did not contest the [[2013 Israeli legislative election|2013 elections]], and subsequently left the Knesset. Since September 2018, he is the Head of the Civil Service Commission under the office of the Prime Minister of Israel.

==Bar-Ilan University==
He was president of [[Bar-Ilan University]] from 2013 to 2017, succeeding [[Moshe Kaveh]] and followed by [[Arie Zaban]].<ref name=bht/><ref name="Board of Trustees Approves Appointment of Rabbi Prof. Daniel Hershkowitz as Next President of Bar-Ilan University">[http://www1.biu.ac.il/indexE.php?id=33&pt=20&pid=4&level=1&cPath=4&type=1&news=1899 Board of Trustees Approves Appointment of Rabbi Prof. Daniel Hershkowitz as Next President of Bar-Ilan University]</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www1.biu.ac.il/indexE.php?id=6551&pt=1&pid=988&level=5&cPath=35,983,988 |title=Bar-Ilan Presidents &#124; Bar Ilan University |publisher=.biu.ac.il |accessdate=2020-02-18}}</ref>
